evd_title: GPT-4 commented on research implications 7.27x more than humans and on novelty 10.69x less on ICLR papers
finding: GPT-4 commented on research implications 7.27x more than humans and on novelty 10.69x less on ICLR papers
I: GPT-4 zero-shot single-pass 4-section feedback; comments extracted by GPT-4; human aspect-coding (11 aspects)
C: Human reviewer comments on same papers; coded by 2 ML annotators
O: Log frequency ratio GPT-4/human: implications 7.27x more; novelty 10.69x less; ablations 6.71x less; more datasets 2.19x more
